name: Multimodal Sleep Stage Benchmark
description: A large-scale benchmark evaluating multimodal sleep stage classification using respiratory signals, actigraphy, and heart rate variability.
reputation: Relevant to sleep and wearable-sensing research with growing interest but not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Clinical labels subject to inter-rater variability and class imbalance; dataset heterogeneity and privacy considerations can limit generalization; non-LLM benchmark focused on physiological signals.
